card.name: Verbs of movement along a path
card.fires_on: A verb or linking word right after 'and', 'are', or 'before' that is about to be followed by a destination or route (to, through, into). Seen in descriptions of larvae, particles, or rivers moving through the body or land.

modes.label: Travel through the body
modes.description: Verbs like carried, migrating or enter describing larvae or particles moving to organs.
modes.example: Larvae breach the intestinal wall and are<< carried>> to the lungs in the blood stream.
